highlights.reason_zh: API、价格、上下文与 coding 集成已同时落地，直接影响模型选择。
highlights.reason_en: API access, pricing, context and coding integrations are live together, directly affecting model choice.

highlights.reason_zh: 规则从日期占位符变成已生效的云算力合规义务。
highlights.reason_en: The rule moved from date placeholders to an effective cloud-compute compliance obligation.

highlights.reason_zh: 开放权重与部署路径让长任务 coding agent 可在本地直接验证。
highlights.reason_en: Open weights and serving paths make long-horizon coding agents directly testable locally.

highlights.reason_zh: 超大规模定价改变产业资本预期，但交易与交割尚未完成。
highlights.reason_en: The unusually large pricing changes industry capital expectations, while trading and closing remain pending.

highlights.reason_zh: Genie 4 从封闭测试走向部分订阅者，但仍不具备通用 API。
highlights.reason_en: Genie 4 moved beyond closed testing to some subscribers, but still lacks a general API.

coverage_zh: 固定入口 36/36 成功，并主动覆盖模型、开发工具、开源、研究、基础设施、政策、中文材料、小团队与重大综合新闻。部分页面只有日期；厂商性能尚待独立验证；无重大综合新闻破例入选。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors succeeded, with active coverage of models, developer tools, open source, research, infrastructure, policy, Chinese-language material, small teams and exceptional general news. Some pages exposed dates only; vendor performance awaits independent validation; no exceptional general-news item was included.
